title: Digital Literacy and Capability Development
short: Building foundational digital skills for the modern world.
long: This program equips young Rwandans with essential digital skills — from computer basics, internet literacy, productivity tools, to coding fundamentals. Participants gain hands-on experience through guided projects, preparing them for further specialization and real-world opportunities in the digital economy.

title: Career Guidance
short: Guiding young minds toward meaningful careers in tech.
long: Our Career Guidance program helps young people discover their strengths, explore tech career paths, and build a clear roadmap. Through mentorship, workshops, CV reviews, and industry exposure, participants gain the confidence and direction needed to launch successful careers.
